module: State manager of the Mesh Spline tool: holds the list of mesh splines (meshSplines) and the id-to-index table (splineMap). It creates, copies, cuts, joins, deletes, serializes and rebuilds the splines, applies presets, manages the links with the Master Spline and provides the editor's undo/redo callbacks. Each spline has a SimGroup folder in MissionGroup (not saved until it is "baked") and receives a UUID via Engine.generateUUID().
notes: A spline is a table: nodes, widths, nmls (source data) and divPoints, divWidths, tangents, binormals, normals, discMap (derived geometry, recomputed). isDirty = true requests a rebuild at the next updateDirtyMeshSplines.
isEnabled = false means locked (baked) spline: its meshes stay in the scene.
isLink / linkId mark a spline driven by a Master Spline; removeAllMeshSplines(false) only deletes active, non-linked splines.
deepCopyMeshSpline goes through buffer.encode/decode and clears the copy's derived tables.
The default preset of a new spline is 'concrete_barrier'.

getToolPrefixStr.desc: Returns the tool's name prefix ("Mesh Spline").

getEditModeKey.desc: Returns the tool's edit mode key.

getMeshSplines.desc: Returns the live table of mesh splines (not copied).

getSplineMap.desc: Returns the live id-to-index table of the splines.

setMeshSpline.desc: Places the spline at the given index, creates its scene folder (SimGroup in MissionGroup, cansave = false) if it does not exist and marks it dirty.

setMeshSplines.desc: Registers all the splines of the table at their indices (calls setMeshSpline for each).

setPreset.desc: Applies a preset (central mesh, caps, spacing, offsets, etc., from the presets table) to the spline: first removes its meshes from the scene, copies the preset parameters, measures the mesh and marks the spline dirty. Does nothing if the spline or the name is nil; an unknown name just clears it and marks it dirty.

getDefaultSliderParams.desc: Returns the default parameters of the interface sliders (bounds, values).

addNewMeshSpline.desc: Adds a new empty mesh spline: unique name, UUID, scene folder, default flags (isEnabled, normalMode = 2, isAliasRoundRobin...), then applies the 'concrete_barrier' preset and updates the id-to-index table.

removeMeshSpline.desc: Deletes the spline at the given index: its meshes, its scene folder, then the list entry; updates the id-to-index table. Crashes if the index does not exist (the spline is read without a test before tryRemove).

findMeshSpline.desc: Finds a live spline by its id.

returns.desc: The spline, or nil if absent.

removeLinkedMeshSpline.desc: Deletes a linked spline by its id (called when a Master Spline layer is removed). Does nothing if the id is unknown.

removeAllMeshSplines.desc: Deletes all the splines. With isIncludeDisabled true, including locked and linked ones; otherwise only the active non-linked ones.

deepCopyMeshSpline.desc: Deep copy of a spline (buffer.encode/decode), with the derived geometry tables cleared.

deepCopyMeshSplineState.desc: Deep copy of the full list of splines (for undo/redo history).

splitMeshSpline.desc: Cuts the selected spline in two at the selected node. A looped spline is simply opened at the cut point. Otherwise the original spline is deleted and replaced by two new splines named <name>_split_A and <name>_split_B that take over its parameters.

joinMeshSplines.desc: Joins two open mesh splines into one: the concatenated geometry (geom.joinSplineGeometry) is written into the first, the second is deleted. Does nothing if an index is invalid or if the nodes do not allow the join.

singleSplineEditUndo.desc: Undo callback for the edit of a single spline (editor history).

meshSplineData.desc: Action data containing the old state.

singleSplineEditRedo.desc: Redo callback for the edit of a single spline.

meshSplineData.desc: Action data containing the new state.

presetSelectionUndo.desc: Undoes the choice of a preset (removes the meshes before applying the old state).

presetSelectionRedo.desc: Redoes the choice of a preset (removes the meshes before applying the new state).

transSplineEditUndo.desc: Undoes a cross-cutting edit across several mesh splines.

transSplineEditRedo.desc: Redoes a cross-cutting edit across several mesh splines.

objectSelectUndo.desc: Undo callback for an object selection operation: puts data.old back in place of the spline with the same id, removes its meshes and marks it dirty.

data.desc: Action data with old and new.

objectSelectRedo.desc: Redo callback for an object selection operation: puts data.new back in place of the spline with the same id.

data.desc: Action data with old and new.

recomputeIdMap.desc: Recomputes the id-to-index table (called by the session utility after a load that adds splines).

copyMeshSplineProfile.desc: Copies a spline's profile (all its parameters without the nodes, widths, normals or derived geometry) to paste it onto another.

pasteMeshSplineProfile.desc: Pastes a profile onto the spline: first removes its meshes, takes the profile's parameters (normalMode, spacing, jitter, vertical offset, etc.) and marks the spline dirty.

updateDirtyMeshSplines.desc: Rebuilds the splines marked dirty: fewer than 2 nodes, removes meshes and geometry; otherwise recomputes the geometry (populationEngine.updateGeometry), repopulates the meshes (populate.populateMeshSpline) and updates roadLength. Then signals an edit to the "meshSpline" session.

serializeMeshSpline.desc: Serializes a spline for the editor buffer: first clears the derived tables of the live spline (which is therefore modified), then returns buffer.encode(spline).

serializeMeshSplineToTable.desc: Serializes a spline into a simple, portable table for a session file (toolUtilities/session). Deep copy via the codec so the live spline is never modified; the derived geometry is cleared (rebuilt afterwards) and the scene handle removed.

deserializeMeshSpline.desc: Deserializes a spline. data is either the editor's encoded blob (string) or a table from a JSON session file; in the latter case the derived tables are created empty and the {x,y,z} positions become vec3 again before the first rebuild.

isCreateObject.desc: true to create the spline's scene SimGroup folder (unless a locked spline already keeps one after a Lua reload).

conformNodesToTerrain.desc: One-shot action: places the control nodes on the surface below (vertical raycast) then marks the spline dirty. Construction stays free in 3D; rerun it after terraforming to re-snap.

convertPathsToMeshSplines.desc: Converts paths drawn from a bitmap into mesh splines: one spline per path, points converted to world coordinates via the terrain editor, normals taken from the terrain. A path that is too small is not imported (the empty spline created stays in the list).

paths.desc: Paths with points ({x,y} in grid) and widths.

getCurrentMeshSplineList.desc: Returns the simplified list of active splines (isEnabled) for the interface: name, id and type.

isLinked.desc: Tells whether the spline with the given id is linked to a Master Spline.

returns.desc: true if linked, false otherwise (or if absent).

setLink.desc: Enables or disables a spline's link (isLink, linkId), removes its meshes and marks it dirty. Does nothing if the id is unknown.

groupId.desc: Identifier of the link group, used as linkId if isLink is true.

isLink.desc: true to link, false to unlink.

updateLinkedMeshSpline.desc: Updates a linked spline with the Master Spline's geometry (nodes, widths, nmls, isLoop, isConformToTerrain). If there are fewer than 2 points, clears the derived geometry and removes the meshes. Marks the spline dirty.

unlinkAll.desc: Unlinks all the mesh splines (isLink = false, linkId = nil) and marks them dirty.
